$comment: Why each workflow runs (spec:AST-030 FR14). Every workflow in .github/workflows has exactly one entry, and workflow-relevance.test.mjs holds each entry to its kind. Kinds: paths (every push and pull-request trigger lists the paths that make it relevant), change-scope (reports required contexts on every pull request; the trusted classifier picks the work inside them), landed-commit (push to main: every landed commit is relevant), review-event (review, comment, check and deployment events; a pull_request_target trigger also records in pullRequestUpdates why every pull-request update matters to review state), schedule (cron, plus manual dispatch), manual (manual dispatch only). No workflow uses paths-ignore.

a11y-weekly.yml.reason: Weekly full accessibility sweep of main.

ci.yml.reason: Reports the required build, test and docsite-test contexts on every pull request; the trusted classifier's positive surfaces choose the work inside them (FR1-FR13).

cli-global-mode-smoke.yml.reason: On-demand smoke test of the globally installed CLI.

cli-smoke-test.yml.reason: Every package the CLI discovers, the workspace's dependency and TypeScript configuration, the setup action and the smoke scripts.

crowdin-upload.yml.reason: The English Core locale catalog, uploaded from main.

deploy.yml.reason: Main's post-merge validation: every landed commit can change what main ships.

hardening-issue.yml.reason: A merged pull request that can add a Core component directory.

lint.yml.reason: Reports the required lint context on every pull request and push to main; the trusted classifier chooses the work inside it.

npm-canary-cleanup.yml.reason: On-demand removal of old canary versions.

pr-comment.yml.reason: Posts the analysis comment after a CI run completes or a preview deploys.

release.yml.reason: Canary publishing from each landed commit on main, and the dispatched release (spec:AST-017).

rerequest-review-on-update.yml.reason: Re-requests review when a pull request's head changes.
rerequest-review-on-update.yml.pullRequestUpdates: Re-requests review from a reviewer who requested changes, once the head changes.

review-clear.yml.reason: Clears or keeps the required review-required status after the review-signal run.

review-signal.yml.reason: Computes the required review-required status from pull-request and review events.
review-signal.yml.pullRequestUpdates: Recomputes the required review-required status for the new head.

rtl-weekly.yml.reason: Weekly full RTL sweep of main.

spec-owner-gate.yml.reason: Posts the required spec-owner-approval status from pull-request, review and approval-comment events.
spec-owner-gate.yml.pullRequestUpdates: Reposts the required spec-owner-approval status for the new head, which an exact-head approval must cover.
